provenance.measured_arms: historical cadence reference pair; reconstruction validated separately
provenance.source_manifest: inherited release module pins with the v1.6 grammar fix described below
provenance.v16_grammar_fix: B5 preserves scheduler widths for structured-output batches, including forced-width requests; upstream constrained speculative sampling is unchanged. Offline regression only; hardware verification pending.
provenance.behavior: B4 group128 QKV shadow banks plus B5 request-local width 7/3 controller on the stock workspace; B1 is absent and must stay absent; no indexer or scheduler override is permitted
provenance.bootstrap_role: zzz_b45.pth is the single import owner; it inserts /opt/b45 on sys.path and imports b45_bootstrap, which redirects only the Python import of the KDA mixed-output module to the sealed /opt/b45 copy. The on-disk original KDA file stays untouched for launcher hash checks.

kda_import_target.role: on-disk bytes the bootstrap asserts before shadowing the import; equals the apply_kda_fg.py contract after-hash

label.meaning: provenance of the measured launch pair; deliberately retained, not a boot counter

output.start_state: must exist and be empty before serving; receipts written during serving are the execution evidence checked by verify
output.restart_policy: a stopped candidate is never restarted with stale receipts; a fresh container is required

execution_evidence.b4_receipts: graphs/activation-<pid>.jsonl, graphs/steps-<pid>.jsonl and graph dot dumps appear under the output directory during real graph capture and decode
execution_evidence.b5_receipts: b5-steps-<hostname>-<pid>.jsonl and b5-receipt-<hostname>-<pid>.json appear under the output directory during controller-driven decode
